scenario:
A global cryptocurrency exchange platform is developing an advanced system for tracking and analyzing real-time and historical cryptocurrency exchange rates. The platform aims to provide users with detailed insights into the performance and trends of various cryptocurrencies against fiat currencies like the US Dollar (USDT). Users can view daily exchange rates, percentage changes, and trends over time to make informed trading decisions.

The system will support multiple cryptocurrencies, each tracked against numerous fiat currencies. It will accommodate high-frequency updates and offer robust analytic tools to monitor market dynamics. The platform should also feature advanced visualization capabilities, allowing users to view historical data trends through interactive charts and graphs.

Additionally, the platform needs a comprehensive user management system to support different user roles, such as traders, analysts, and administrators. Security features are paramount to protect user data and ensure safe trading activities. The platform also requires a notification system to alert users about significant market changes or specific thresholds they set.
